mention.example_en: Dad forgot to mention the parent meeting at dinner.
mention.example_zh: 爸爸吃晚饭时忘了提及家长会。

miss.example_en: I still miss my primary school friends on weekends.
miss.example_zh: 到了周末，我仍然想念小学的朋友。

moan.example_en: The sick boy began to moan in the nurse's office.
moan.example_zh: 那个生病的男孩在医务室里开始呻吟。

monitor.example_en: Teachers monitor the hallway during the lunch break.
monitor.example_zh: 老师们在午休时间监视走廊。

motivate.example_en: A kind comment can motivate a shy student in class.
motivate.example_zh: 一句善意的评语就能激励班上害羞的学生。

mount.example_en: Cyclists mount the last hill before the school gate.
mount.example_zh: 骑车的人在校门前登上最后一座小山。

move.example_en: Could you move your chair so the aisle stays clear?
move.example_zh: 你能把椅子挪一下，好让过道保持畅通吗？

need.example_en: Plants on the classroom windowsill need water and sunlight.
need.example_zh: 教室窗台上的植物需要水和阳光。

observe.example_en: In science class we observe how ice melts in a bowl.
observe.example_zh: 科学课上，我们观察冰块在碗里怎样融化。

occur.example_en: Power cuts often occur during summer storms in our town.
occur.example_zh: 我们镇上夏天暴风雨时经常发生停电。

offer.example_en: The canteen will offer free soup on rainy days.
offer.example_zh: 下雨天食堂会提供免费的汤。

operate.example_en: Only trained staff may operate the lab projector.
operate.example_zh: 只有受过培训的人员可以操作实验室的投影仪。

oppose.example_en: Many parents oppose closing the school library on Saturdays.
oppose.example_zh: 许多家长反对星期六关闭学校图书馆。

outline.example_en: The captain will outline the match plan before kickoff.
outline.example_zh: 队长会在开球前概述比赛计划。

overcome.example_en: She managed to overcome her fear of speaking in class.
overcome.example_zh: 她设法克服了在课堂上发言的恐惧。

overlook.example_en: From the hill we overlook the whole sports field.
overlook.example_zh: 我们从山上俯瞰整个运动场。

owe.example_en: I owe my sister ten yuan for yesterday's bus ticket.
owe.example_zh: 昨天的公交车票钱，我还欠姐姐十元。

paint.example_en: Our class will paint the hallway wall this weekend.
paint.example_zh: 我们班这个周末要油漆走廊的墙壁。

pass.example_en: We pass the bakery every day on the way home.
pass.example_zh: 我们每天回家路上都会经过那家面包店。

pay.example_en: I will pay for the noodles with my lunch card.
pay.example_zh: 我要用饭卡付面条的钱。

perform.example_en: The drama club will perform a short play on Friday.
perform.example_zh: 戏剧社星期五将表演一个短剧。

permit.example_en: The school does not permit mobile phones during morning exams.
permit.example_zh: 学校不允许在上午的考试中使用手机。

persuade.example_en: Can you persuade your brother to share the last cake?
persuade.example_zh: 你能说服弟弟分享最后一块蛋糕吗？

pick.example_en: She helped me pick a clean shirt for the school photo.
pick.example_zh: 她帮我为学校拍照挑了一件干净衬衫。

play.example_en: They play basketball on the outdoor court after lunch.
play.example_zh: 他们午饭后在室外球场打篮球。

possess.example_en: You must possess a student card to enter the lab.
possess.example_zh: 你必须拥有学生证才能进入实验室。

post.example_en: Students post club notices on the board by the stairs.
post.example_zh: 学生们把社团通知张贴在楼梯旁的布告栏上。

pour.example_en: Mum asked me to pour tea for our guests.

practise.example_en: I practise the piano for twenty minutes after supper.
practise.example_zh: 晚饭后我练习二十分钟钢琴。

pray.example_en: Some families pray together before the evening meal.
pray.example_zh: 有些家庭在晚饭前一起祈祷。

predict.example_en: Old farmers predict a storm when the swallows fly low.
predict.example_zh: 燕子低飞时，老农便能预测暴风雨将至。

present.example_en: Each group will present its survey results on Monday.
present.example_zh: 每个小组将在星期一展示调查结果。

preserve.example_en: We preserve strawberries in jars after the school fair.
preserve.example_zh: 学校义卖之后，我们把草莓装进罐子里保存。

pretend.example_en: Little Tom likes to pretend he is a train driver.
pretend.example_zh: 小汤姆喜欢假装自己是火车司机。

prevent.example_en: Seat belts prevent serious injury on the school bus.
prevent.example_zh: 安全带可以防止校车上发生严重伤害。

print.example_en: The office can print your timetable before the first lesson.
print.example_zh: 办公室可以在第一节课之前打印你的课程表。

proceed.example_en: We should proceed with the experiment after the break.
proceed.example_zh: 休息之后我们应该继续做实验。

produce.example_en: Our school garden can produce enough tomatoes for lunch.
produce.example_zh: 学校菜园能生产出够午饭吃的西红柿。

promise.example_en: I promise to return your ruler after maths class.
promise.example_zh: 我承诺数学课后把尺子还给你。

promote.example_en: Sports day can promote teamwork among the younger students.
promote.example_zh: 运动会能促进低年级学生之间的团队合作。

propose.example_en: Lily will propose a picnic if Saturday stays sunny.
propose.example_zh: 如果星期六一直晴朗，莉莉会提议去野餐。

protect.example_en: Thick coats protect us from the wind at the bus stop.
protect.example_zh: 在公交车站，厚外套保护我们免受风吹。

prove.example_en: These results prove that regular sleep helps exam scores.
prove.example_zh: 这些结果证明规律睡眠有助于考试成绩。

provide.example_en: The hotel will provide breakfast for the visiting team.
provide.example_zh: 酒店将为来访的队伍提供早餐。

publish.example_en: A local publisher will publish the class history book.
publish.example_zh: 一家当地出版社将出版这本班级史书。

pull.example_en: Don't pull the curtain so hard or it will tear.
pull.example_zh: 别那么用力拉窗帘，不然会扯破。

purchase.example_en: We purchase fruit from the market before the picnic.
purchase.example_zh: 野餐前我们从市场购买水果。

push.example_en: You should push the door, not pull the handle.
push.example_zh: 你应该推这扇门，而不是拉门把手。

put.example_en: Put the milk back in the fridge after breakfast.
put.example_zh: 早饭后把牛奶放回冰箱。

qualify.example_en: Hard training can help you qualify for the city team.
qualify.example_zh: 刻苦训练能帮你取得市队的资格。

quote.example_en: Hotels quote a lower price for groups of students.
quote.example_zh: 酒店给学生团体报出更低的价格。

raise.example_en: Ticket sales will raise money for the new library books.
raise.example_zh: 门票收入将为图书馆的新书筹集资金。

reach.example_en: We usually reach the stadium before the match starts.
reach.example_zh: 我们通常在比赛开始前到达体育场。

read.example_en: I read the bus timetable while I wait outside.
read.example_zh: 我在外面等车时读公交时刻表。

realise.example_en: I didn't realise the library closes early on Wednesday.
realise.example_zh: 我没有意识到图书馆星期三提早关门。

realize.example_en: You will realize your mistake once you check the map.
realize.example_zh: 你一核对地图，就会意识到自己的错误。

recall.example_en: Can you recall where we left the picnic blanket?
recall.example_zh: 你能回忆起我们把野餐毯落在哪儿了吗？

receive.example_en: Did you receive the parcel from your aunt today?
receive.example_zh: 你今天收到阿姨寄来的包裹了吗？

recognise.example_en: I didn't recognise my cousin in his new school uniform.
recognise.example_zh: 我没有认出穿着新校服的表哥。

recognize.example_en: You might recognize that song from the school concert.
recognize.example_zh: 你也许能认出那首学校音乐会上的歌。

recommend.example_en: Our teacher will recommend two novels for the holiday.
recommend.example_zh: 我们老师会为假期推荐两本小说。

recover.example_en: It took him a week to recover from that bad cold.
recover.example_zh: 他过了一周才从那场重感冒中恢复过来。

recruit.example_en: The football club will recruit new players in September.
recruit.example_zh: 足球俱乐部将在九月招募新队员。

reduce.example_en: Walking to school can reduce the family's fuel costs.
reduce.example_zh: 步行上学可以减少家里的油费开支。

refer.example_en: Always refer to the map if you miss the turning.
refer.example_zh: 如果错过路口，一定要查阅地图。

reflect.example_en: His diary may reflect how he felt during exams.
reflect.example_zh: 他的日记也许反映了他考试期间的心情。

refuse.example_en: She might refuse the extra cake because she is full.
refuse.example_zh: 她可能会拒绝多出来的蛋糕，因为她已经吃饱了。

regard.example_en: I regard my coach as a patient and honest person.
regard.example_zh: 我把教练看作一个耐心又诚实的人。

register.example_en: New students register at the office on the first day.
register.example_zh: 新生第一天到办公室登记。

relate.example_en: These photos relate to our trip last summer.
relate.example_zh: 这些照片与我们去年夏天的旅行有关。

release.example_en: The zoo will release the healed bird next Saturday.
release.example_zh: 动物园将在下星期六释放那只痊愈的鸟。

rely.example_en: Hikers rely on a paper map when phones lose signal.
rely.example_zh: 手机没有信号时，徒步的人依靠纸质地图。

remain.example_en: Passengers remain in their seats until the bus stops.
remain.example_zh: 乘客要留在座位上，直到公交车停下。

remind.example_en: These signs remind drivers to slow down near the school.
remind.example_zh: 这些标志提醒司机在学校附近减速。

remove.example_en: Remove the broken chair from the classroom aisle.
remove.example_zh: 把那把坏椅子从教室过道里搬走。

repeat.example_en: Could you repeat the address so I can write it?
repeat.example_zh: 你能把地址再重复一遍，好让我写下来吗？

replace.example_en: We should replace the cracked window before winter.
replace.example_zh: 入冬之前我们应该换掉那扇裂了的窗户。

represent.example_en: Two students represent our class at the city forum.
represent.example_zh: 两名学生在城市论坛上代表我们班。

require.example_en: This form will require a parent's signature by Friday.
require.example_zh: 这张表格需要家长在星期五前签字。

reserve.example_en: We reserve the front seats for visiting parents.
reserve.example_zh: 我们为来访的家长保留前排座位。

resist.example_en: The villagers will resist the plan to close their clinic.
resist.example_zh: 村民们将抵制关闭他们诊所的计划。

resolve.example_en: They resolve to finish the model before the science fair.
resolve.example_zh: 他们决定在科学展之前完成这个模型。

restore.example_en: Rest can restore your energy after a long match.
restore.example_zh: 长时间比赛之后，休息能恢复你的体力。

retain.example_en: Visitors retain their tickets until they leave the museum.
retain.example_zh: 参观者在离开博物馆之前一直保留着门票。

retire.example_en: Grandpa will retire from the post office next year.
retire.example_zh: 爷爷明年将从邮局退休。

return.example_en: Remember to return the library books before Friday.
return.example_zh: 记得在星期五之前归还图书馆的书。

revise.example_en: I revise my history notes on the bus home.
revise.example_zh: 我在回家的公交车上复习历史笔记。

ride.example_en: Children ride their bikes along the river after school.
ride.example_zh: 孩子们放学后沿着河边骑自行车。

ring.example_en: I will ring the office if the bus arrives late.
ring.example_zh: 如果公交车晚点，我会给办公室打电话。

rise.example_en: The sun will rise behind the hills before breakfast.
rise.example_zh: 太阳会在早饭前从山丘后面升起。

roll.example_en: The ball may roll under the sofa during the game.
roll.example_zh: 游戏进行时，球可能会滚到沙发底下。

run.example_en: I run around the playground before morning class.
run.example_zh: 上午上课前，我绕着操场跑步。

rush.example_en: Don't rush across the road when the light is red.
rush.example_zh: 红灯亮时不要冲过马路。

satisfy.example_en: A simple lunch can satisfy us after football practice.
satisfy.example_zh: 足球训练之后，一顿简单的午饭就能使我们满意。

save.example_en: Lifeguards save swimmers who drift too far from shore.
save.example_zh: 救生员救起那些漂得离岸太远的游泳者。

say.example_en: What did Grandma say about the burnt rice?
say.example_zh: 奶奶对烧糊的米饭说了什么？

scan.example_en: I scan the menu before I order lunch.
scan.example_zh: 我点午餐之前先扫读一遍菜单。

scream.example_en: The injured player began to scream on the football pitch.
scream.example_zh: 那名受伤的球员在足球场上开始惨叫。

secure.example_en: Riders secure their bikes with a lock near the gate.
secure.example_zh: 骑车的人在大门附近用锁把自行车锁好。

see.example_en: I can see the mountains from our upstairs window.
see.example_zh: 从我们楼上的窗户能看见群山。

seek.example_en: Graduates often seek part-time work during the summer.
seek.example_zh: 毕业生常常在夏天寻求兼职工作。

seem.example_en: You seem tired after the long maths test.
seem.example_zh: 漫长的数学测验之后，你似乎很疲倦。

select.example_en: We select fresh apples at the market on Saturday.
select.example_zh: 星期六我们在市场挑选新鲜的苹果。

sell.example_en: Farmers sell sweet corn outside the school on Fridays.
sell.example_zh: 农民星期五在学校外面出售甜玉米。

send.example_en: I will send Grandma a photo of the snowman.
send.example_zh: 我要给奶奶发送一张雪人的照片。

serve.example_en: Volunteers serve hot porridge at the winter fair.
serve.example_zh: 志愿者在冬季义卖会上端上热粥。

set.example_en: He will set the plates on the table before dinner.
set.example_zh: 他会在晚饭前把盘子放到桌上。

settle.example_en: The two teams must settle the argument after the game.
settle.example_zh: 两支队伍必须在比赛结束后解决这场争执。

shake.example_en: Shake the bottle before you pour the juice.
shake.example_zh: 倒果汁之前先把瓶子摇一摇。

share.example_en: Would you share your umbrella with me in the rain?
share.example_zh: 下雨时你愿意和我分享你的伞吗？

shave.example_en: Dad likes to shave before he leaves for work.
shave.example_zh: 爸爸喜欢出门上班前先刮脸。

shoot.example_en: He can shoot the ball into the net from far away.
shoot.example_zh: 他能从远处把球投进球网。

shout.example_en: Don't shout in the corridor during the lesson.
shout.example_zh: 上课期间不要在走廊里叫喊。

show.example_en: Good players show real courage when the match gets hard.
show.example_zh: 比赛变得艰难时，优秀的球员会表现出真正的勇气。

shut.example_en: Someone should shut the window if the rain starts.
shut.example_zh: 如果下起雨来，应该有人把窗户关上。

sing.example_en: The choir will sing folk songs at the spring concert.
sing.example_zh: 合唱团将在春季音乐会上演唱民歌。

sit.example_en: Let's sit under the tree while we eat lunch.
sit.example_zh: 我们吃午饭时坐到那棵树下去吧。

situate.example_en: Guidebooks situate the temple halfway up the mountain.
situate.example_zh: 旅游手册把那座寺庙标在半山腰的位置。

slap.example_en: The wind can slap the wet flag against the pole.
slap.example_zh: 风会把湿旗子拍打在旗杆上。

sleep.example_en: Babies sleep better when the room stays quiet.
sleep.example_zh: 房间保持安静时，婴儿睡得更好。

slip.example_en: You might slip on the icy steps outside the dorm.
slip.example_zh: 你可能会在宿舍外结冰的台阶上滑倒。

solve.example_en: Together we can solve this maths problem before lunch.
solve.example_zh: 午饭前我们可以一起解决这道数学题。

speak.example_en: Guides speak more slowly so the visitors understand.
speak.example_zh: 导游说得更慢一些，好让参观的人听懂。

specialise.example_en: This hospital will specialise in sports injuries next year.
specialise.example_zh: 这家医院明年将专攻运动损伤。

specify.example_en: The recipe should specify how much sugar to add.
specify.example_zh: 食谱应当列明要加多少糖。

spend.example_en: Teenagers often spend too much money on snacks.
spend.example_zh: 青少年常常在零食上花费太多钱。

spill.example_en: Don't spill soup on your clean shirt at lunch.
spill.example_zh: 午饭时别把汤洒在干净衬衫上。

split.example_en: We can split the sandwich if you are still hungry.
split.example_zh: 如果你还饿，我们可以把三明治分开吃。

spread.example_en: Bad news can spread quickly through a small school.
spread.example_zh: 坏消息能在一所小学校里迅速传播。

stand.example_en: We stand behind the white line while the train passes.
stand.example_zh: 火车经过时，我们站在白线后面。

start.example_en: The film will start at seven in the school hall.
start.example_zh: 电影将于七点在学校礼堂开始。

stay.example_en: Can you stay for dinner after the piano lesson?
stay.example_zh: 钢琴课结束后，你能留下来吃晚饭吗？

steal.example_en: Nobody should steal food from another student's bag.
steal.example_zh: 谁都不应该从别的同学书包里偷食物。

stick.example_en: Wet leaves stick to our shoes on autumn paths.
stick.example_zh: 在秋天的小路上，湿叶子会粘在我们的鞋上。

stink.example_en: Those old shoes stink after a rainy football match.
stink.example_zh: 那些旧鞋在一场下雨的足球赛之后发臭。

stop.example_en: The bus will stop outside the museum at noon.
stop.example_zh: 公交车中午会停在博物馆外面。

stretch.example_en: Runners stretch their legs before they leave the track.
stretch.example_zh: 跑步的人离开跑道前会伸展双腿。

strike.example_en: Lightning may strike the tall tree behind the gym.
strike.example_zh: 闪电可能会击中体育馆后面的大树。

struggle.example_en: Some students struggle with long division at first.
struggle.example_zh: 有些学生一开始做长除法时很吃力。

study.example_en: I study chemistry with my friend on Sunday evenings.
study.example_zh: 我星期日晚上和朋友一起学习化学。

submit.example_en: Candidates submit their forms to the office by Thursday.
submit.example_zh: 考生须在星期四前把表格提交到办公室。

suffer.example_en: Many people suffer from hay fever in late spring.
suffer.example_zh: 晚春时节，许多人因花粉热而受苦。

suggest.example_en: Could you suggest a quiet place for group study?
suggest.example_zh: 你能建议一个适合小组学习的安静地方吗？

suit.example_en: Does this blue jacket suit me for the interview?
suit.example_zh: 这件蓝色夹克适合我面试时穿吗？

supply.example_en: Ships supply fresh water to the island school each week.
supply.example_zh: 船只每周给岛上的学校补给淡水。

suppose.example_en: I suppose the match will continue if the rain stops.
suppose.example_zh: 我想如果雨停了，比赛就会继续。

swim.example_en: We swim in the indoor pool on cold winter days.
swim.example_zh: 寒冷的冬日里，我们在室内泳池游泳。

switch.example_en: Some families switch from driving to cycling this month.
switch.example_zh: 这个月有些家庭从开车转变为骑自行车。

tackle.example_en: The council must tackle the litter problem near the shops.
tackle.example_zh: 市政部门必须处理商店附近的垃圾问题。

take.example_en: You ought to take an umbrella because the sky looks grey.
take.example_zh: 天色看起来灰蒙蒙的，你应该带一把伞。

talk.example_en: My uncle likes to talk with neighbours over the fence.
talk.example_zh: 我叔叔喜欢隔着篱笆和邻居谈话。

teach.example_en: Grandma can teach us how to make steamed buns.
teach.example_zh: 奶奶能教我们怎样做馒头。

tell.example_en: I will tell the driver where I need to get off.
tell.example_zh: 我会告诉司机我要在哪里下车。

tend.example_en: I tend to forget my water bottle on Mondays.
tend.example_zh: 每到星期一，我往往会忘记带水瓶。

thank.example_en: We thank the cooks when the festival dinner ends.
thank.example_zh: 节日晚宴结束时，我们感谢厨师们。

think.example_en: I think the blue shoes look better with that dress.
think.example_zh: 我觉得那双蓝鞋配那条裙子更好看。

threaten.example_en: The heavy rain may threaten the riverside football pitch.
threaten.example_zh: 大雨可能会威胁到河边的足球场。

throw.example_en: Don't throw paper onto the grass beside the court.
throw.example_zh: 不要把纸扔到球场旁边的草地上。

tie.example_en: Remember to tie your laces before you join the race.
tie.example_zh: 参加赛跑前记得把鞋带系好。

trace.example_en: Police can trace the lost bag through the cameras.
trace.example_zh: 警方可以通过摄像头追踪丢失的包。

train.example_en: The club will train new swimmers this term.
train.example_zh: 俱乐部这学期将训练新来的游泳队员。

transfer.example_en: The bank can transfer the fee straight to the school.
transfer.example_zh: 银行可以把这笔费用直接转到学校。

transform.example_en: Colours and lights can transform the hall for the dance.
transform.example_zh: 色彩和灯光能把礼堂转变成舞会场地。

translate.example_en: Can you translate this menu so my aunt can order?
translate.example_zh: 你能翻译这份菜单，好让我阿姨点菜吗？

travel.example_en: We travel by train when we visit my uncle's city.
travel.example_zh: 我们去叔叔所在的城市时坐火车旅行。

treat.example_en: Nurses treat small cuts in the school medical room.
treat.example_zh: 护士在学校医务室里治疗小伤口。

try.example_en: Let's try the new noodle shop after the concert.
try.example_zh: 音乐会结束后，我们去尝尝那家新面馆吧。

turn.example_en: Cars turn left at the bookshop and then go uphill.
turn.example_zh: 汽车在书店那儿向左转，然后往上坡开。

understand.example_en: I understand the diagram once the teacher adds labels.
understand.example_zh: 老师加上标注之后，我就理解了这张图。

undertake.example_en: The factory will undertake the repair of the school roof.
undertake.example_zh: 这家工厂将承担学校屋顶的修理工作。

update.example_en: Parents update phone numbers on the class contact list.
update.example_zh: 家长在班级联系名单上更新电话号码。

upset.example_en: The cat may upset the milk bowl on the kitchen table.
upset.example_zh: 猫可能会打翻厨房桌上的牛奶碗。

use.example_en: We use chopsticks at home and forks at the canteen.
use.example_zh: 我们在家用筷子，在食堂用叉子。

visit.example_en: We visit the science museum with our class each spring.
visit.example_zh: 每年春天我们都和全班一起参观科学博物馆。

vote.example_en: Students vote for a class monitor at the start of term.
vote.example_zh: 学生们在学期开始时投票选举班长。

wait.example_en: Families wait under the shelter until the rain eases.
wait.example_zh: 家人们在避雨处一直等到雨势变小。

wake.example_en: Birds wake early when the sun hits the garden.
wake.example_zh: 阳光照到花园时，鸟儿很早就会醒来。

walk.example_en: We walk home together when the last class ends.
walk.example_zh: 最后一节课结束后，我们一起步行回家。

want.example_en: I want a bowl of hot soup after skating practice.
want.example_zh: 滑冰训练之后，我想要一碗热汤。

warn.example_en: The signs warn cyclists about the narrow bridge ahead.
warn.example_zh: 这些标志警告骑车的人前方有一座窄桥。

wash.example_en: Children wash their hands before they cut the apples.
wash.example_zh: 孩子们在切苹果之前先把手洗干净。

watch.example_en: We watch the fireworks from the school rooftop.
watch.example_zh: 我们从学校的屋顶观看烟花。

wear.example_en: Students wear white shirts on Monday at our school.
wear.example_zh: 在我们学校，学生们星期一穿白衬衫。

welcome.example_en: We welcome new neighbours with tea and mooncakes.
welcome.example_zh: 我们用茶和月饼欢迎新来的邻居。

win.example_en: Our relay team can win if the last runner starts well.
win.example_zh: 如果最后一棒起跑顺利，我们的接力队就能赢。

wish.example_en: I wish the rain would stop before the match.
wish.example_zh: 我希望雨在比赛开始前停下来。

withdraw.example_en: The writer may withdraw the article before it is printed.
withdraw.example_zh: 作者可以在文章付印之前把它撤回。

wonder.example_en: I wonder why the bakery is closed this afternoon.
wonder.example_zh: 我想知道这家面包店今天下午为什么关门。

work.example_en: My aunt will work at the hospital on night shifts.
work.example_zh: 我阿姨将在医院上夜班。

write.example_en: Students write their names on the cover of the notebook.
write.example_zh: 学生们把名字写在笔记本的封面上。
